candidates.title: Poster: NeuroCERT: Executable Testing for Oracle-Limited Biophysical Network Simulation
candidates.authors: Seungyoun Lee, Hyun Jae Jang, Jae-Ho Han
candidates.venue: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Software Testing, Verification and Validation (ICST)
candidates.found_via: Semantic Scholar API forward citations of SciUnit ICSE 2014 (DOI:10.1145/2591062.2591129); metadata verified via Crossref API; abstract from Semantic Scholar paper API (IEEE Xplore page returned no content)
candidates.why_relevant: Short ICST 2026 poster paper proposing an executable regression-testing layer for biophysical network simulations where no single expected output exists: run provenance, pre-run structural constraints and stochastic batch-level regression criteria. Closest software-testing framing of neural-simulation regression found, but per its abstract it targets network models with stochastic outputs and does not describe controlled mutants, multi-protocol current-clamp batteries, feature fingerprints, numerical-refinement tolerances or protocol selection.

candidates.title: A universal workflow for creation, validation, and generalization of detailed neuronal models
candidates.authors: Maria Reva, Christian Rössert, Alexis Arnaudon, Tanguy Damart, Darshan Mandge, Anıl Tuncel, Srikanth Ramaswamy, Henry Markram, Werner Van Geit
candidates.found_via: Europe PMC citations of BluePyOpt (MED 27375471); also Semantic Scholar citations of BluePyOpt; Crossref-verified
candidates.why_relevant: BluePyEModel-style workflow: models optimized on eFEL features, then validated on additional stimuli not used for fitting and tested for generalization across a population of similar morphologies. Shares multi-protocol features plus held-out-stimulus and held-out-morphology evaluation, but its goal is fitting data, not detecting behaviour changes introduced by edits or mutations.

candidates.title: HippoUnit: A software tool for the automated testing and systematic comparison of detailed models of hippocampal neurons based on electrophysiological data
candidates.authors: Sára Sáray, Christian A. Rössert, Shailesh Appukuttan, Rosanna Migliore, Paola Vitale, Carmen A. Lupascu, Luca L. Bologna, Werner Van Geit, Armando Romani, Andrew P. Davison, Eilif Muller, Tamás F. Freund, Szabolcs Káli

candidates.why_relevant: HippoUnit: SciUnit-based Python test suite that automatically runs many electrophysiological tests (somatic behaviour, dendritic propagation) on several ModelDB CA1 models and scores them against data. Covers automated multi-test characterization of many neuron models; no mutation, tolerance calibration by refinement, protocol-battery optimization or held-out evaluation described in the abstract.

candidates.title: NeuronUnit: A package for data-driven validation of neuron models using SciUnit
candidates.authors: Richard C. Gerkin, Justas Birgiolas, Russell J. Jarvis, Cyrus Omar, Sharon M. Crook
candidates.found_via: Anchor located via OpenAlex search; citations via Semantic Scholar (8), OpenCitations (11), Europe PMC (2)
candidates.why_relevant: NeuronUnit: SciUnit library of data-driven validation tests for single-neuron models, integrated with NeuroML, NeuroElectro and Allen data. Canonical neuron-model testing framework NeuroSem would build beside; tests compare model to experimental features rather than model versions to each other, and no mutation-based evaluation or protocol selection is described. PyPI package neuronunit 0.1.8.2 (MIT) retrieved from https://pypi.org/pypi/neuronunit/json.

candidates.title: Collaborative infrastructure for test-driven scientific model validation

candidates.why_relevant: SciUnit origin paper (ICSE 2014 companion): test-driven, collaborative validation of scientific models using executable unit-test-like validation tests. Establishes the model-testing paradigm; not neuron-edit regression, mutation-calibrated, or protocol-optimized.

candidates.title: Unit testing, model validation, and biological simulation

candidates.title: Reproducing and quantitatively validating a biologically-constrained point-neuron model of CA1 pyramidal cells

candidates.title: Reproducible Neural Network Simulations: Statistical Methods for Model Validation on the Level of Network Activity Data

candidates.title: Towards systematic, data-driven validation of a collaborative, multi-scale model of Caenorhabditis elegans

candidates.title: Optimizing experimental designs for model selection of ion channel drug-binding mechanisms
